summary: ArriVent BioPharma filed an 8-K disclosing the filing of a prospectus supplement to its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The supplement allows the company to sell up to $250 million of common stock through Jefferies LLC as sales agent under an Open Market Sale Agreement dated February 3, 2025. No merger, tender offer, divestiture, restructuring, or special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine capital markets activity (an ATM takedown under an S-3ASR) and does not fall into any of the defined special-situations categories.
